# `set_view_plan_wide_setting`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Set the wide-camera capture type, frame size and optional exposure settings used by view plans, saving the previous settings for later restore.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | method (client sends) |
| Grade | MUTATOR / probable (64-bit build; absent from the 32-bit build) |
| Side-effect tier | C |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, handler @0xdf0c0, SetViewPlanStackSetting @0x1a0ce0, SetStackSetting @0x19b230 (64-bit build only) |

Only on the device process type 2 (the meaning of that value is not established here; a different process replies 210). Copies the current stack settings, sets the supplied wide-camera fields (and the optional exposure group) and applies them. The first apply while no snapshot is held saves the prior settings so restore_view_plan_wide_setting can undo it. Before applying, the device also clears the saved stack-result filename and duration and resets the image id to 65535, so get_view_plan_stack_result output changes even if the apply later fails. Application is not shown to be transactional and the relative order of the Setting event and the reply is not established. Registered in the 64-bit build only; no 32-bit support is inferred.

Side effects: Updates persistent stack and camera settings synchronously, stores a prior-settings snapshot (first apply only), resets the saved stack-result metadata, and may emit a Setting event listing changed fields (wide_cam, and a stack object with members such as capt_type, wide_size_index, scene_separate, scene_shooting_duration_min and exposure members; no full snapshot is established). No explicit timeout.

## Request params

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | any | yes | - | Client-chosen request identifier, echoed in the reply as parsed (same JSON type). Required; a request without one is rejected with code 200. The device accepts any JSON value: zero, negative, string, null, boolean and composite ids are all treated as real requests, not notifications. Clients SHOULD use an integer or a string and SHOULD keep ids unique among outstanding requests. On early dispatcher errors (100, 200) the reply carries id null. [READ] |
| `method` | string | yes | - | Fixed value `"set_view_plan_wide_setting"`. [READ] |
| `params` | object | yes | - | Object required (an array is not accepted). Unknown members are ignored. The four optional members form one group: either all absent (the held value is kept) or all four supplied. Integer members use signed 32-bit storage; acceptance of larger integer tokens is unresolved. [READ] |
| `params.capt_type` | integer | yes | - | Capture type of the wide-camera plan. Other integers are rejected with 209; a missing or non-integer value with 104. The meaning of each value is not established. One of: `0`, `4`, `5`. [READ] |
| `params.wide_size_index` | integer | yes | - | Wide-camera frame size index. Outside 0..3 is rejected with 204; missing or non-integer with 104. Range: >= 0, <= 3. [READ] |
| `params.scene_separate` | boolean\|integer | if `auto_exp_enable` present | - | Optional group member. Integer 0 is false, nonzero true; a wrong type is rejected with 106. Meaning inferred from the key name only. [READ] |
| `params.scene_shooting_duration_min` | integer | if `auto_exp_enable` present | - | Optional group member, minutes (unit INFERRED). Below 1 is rejected with 204; no upper bound in the handler. Range: >= 1. [READ] |
| `params.exp_ms` | integer | if `auto_exp_enable` present | - | Optional group member, milliseconds (unit INFERRED). Below 1 is rejected with 204. Acceptance does not mean the value is retained: a changed exposure goes through state-dependent normalisation (on the inspected wide-camera path the allowed set is 10000, 20000, 30000 and 60000 ms and any other value becomes 10000; other routes differ), so a code-0 reply does not prove the requested exposure was kept. Range: >= 1. [READ] |
| `params.auto_exp_enable` | boolean\|integer | if `auto_exp_enable` present | - | Optional group member. Integer 0 is false, nonzero true; a wrong type is rejected with 106. [READ] |

## Errors

| Code | Trigger | Label |
|---|---|---|
| 210 | Device process type is not 2 | `not supported` |
| 107 | params absent or not an object | `expected object param` |
| 104 | capt_type or wide_size_index missing or not an integer, or an optional integer member missing or not an integer when the group is used | `expected int param` |
| 209 | capt_type is not 0, 4 or 5 | `invalid value` |
| 204 | wide_size_index outside 0..3, or scene_shooting_duration_min or exp_ms below 1 | `out of limit` |
| 106 | scene_separate or auto_exp_enable present with a type other than boolean or integer | `expected bool param` |
| 524 | Apply failed because the stack simulator is still enabled while the exposure changes | `function conflict` |
| 200 | Dispatcher: request has no id | `invalid id` |
| 100 | Dispatcher: method missing or not a string | `invalid request` |

Other state-dependent apply failures are reachable and are not exhaustively enumerated.

## Example

Request, request - Required members only:

```json
{"id":50,"method":"set_view_plan_wide_setting","params":{"capt_type":0,"wide_size_index":1}}
```

Request, with-exposure - With the optional exposure group:

```json
{"id":51,"method":"set_view_plan_wide_setting","params":{"capt_type":4,"wide_size_index":0,"scene_separate":false,"scene_shooting_duration_min":20,"exp_ms":10000,"auto_exp_enable":false}}
```

Reply, ok:

```json
{"method":"set_view_plan_wide_setting","result":0,"code":0,"id":50}
```

Reply, bad-capt-type:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","method":"set_view_plan_wide_setting","error":"invalid value","code":209,"id":52}
```
